_doc: Accounting for every declaration site that leaves the layout's inline <style>.
Origin of truth is css-layout-origin.json (184 sites, frozen, never regenerated).
Each origin site must end up in exactly ONE of: still present in the layout,
migrated (moved verbatim), changed (moved with a different rendered value), or
deleted (rule removed). LayoutMigrationLedgerTest enforces that partition, so a
site cannot quietly vanish from one fixture and reappear in the other with a
different colour just because both fixtures were regenerated in the same commit.
migrated: site => value. Must appear in css-neutral-baseline.json with EXACTLY
changed:  site => {from, to, reason}. 'from' must equal the origin value and 'to'
must equal what css-neutral-baseline.json now renders. Every entry needs
a matching case in ContrastGuardTest — a deliberate colour change is the
one situation where the golden fixture cannot vouch for the result.
deleted:  site => reason. Dead rules (no element carries the class) and rules that
only shadowed a dark: variant the component already declares.

.ptah-switcher-tab--active|light|color.reason: acompanha a troca do fundo para o token de marca: passa a usar --ptah-text-on-accent em vez de branco fixo, hoje com o mesmo valor renderizado

.ptah-switcher-tab:hover|dark|background.reason: azul congelado do hover passa a derivar de --ptah-primary via --ptah-primary-soft-d, seguindo a marca escolhida pelo host em vez de um tom fixo

.ptah-switcher-tab:hover|light|backgroun.reason: azul congelado do hover passa a derivar de --ptah-primary, seguindo a marca escolhida pelo host em vez de um tom fixo

.ptah-switcher-tab:hover|dark|color.reason: cor de texto do hover passa a derivar de --ptah-primary via --ptah-primary-lite, seguindo a marca escolhida pelo host. O mix de --ptah-primary-lite caiu de 55% para 45% no mesmo passo: a 55% a combinacao primary-lite sobre primary-soft-d media 4.47:1 com o primary default de config/ptah.php, abaixo do minimo 4.5:1 — falha que ja existia em 4 componentes publicados do BaseCrud e nao foi introduzida por esta migracao. Ver ContrastGuardTest::primary_lite_ink_on_a_primary_soft_pill_passes_aa_for_both_default_primaries.

.ptah-switcher-tab:hover|light|color.reason: cor de texto do hover passa a derivar de --ptah-primary via --ptah-primary-strong, seguindo a marca escolhida pelo host
